CustomField.description: Only the first N matching records, in the order of the order by field, are calculated. Read by Sum, Average, Minimum, Maximum and the text lists; blank means every record (ADR-0136).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: For example 5 with Amount in Descending order for the sum of the 5 largest gifts. Needs an order by field. Leave blank to count every record.
CustomField.label: Row Limit
